# Pulse 1.0.399

- Charging animation: fifteen looks (ring, liquid, bolt, ripple, bar, heartbeat, rising lights, orbit, battery, aurora, honeycomb, radar, sparks, swirl, edge light) plus random. It is off until its switch is on in the screen cover's settings; a tap on a look previews it.
- What's new: rewritten for this version.
- Keyboard: Turkish and English corrections are faster; words typed without a space are split; the word the finger was aiming at is offered when a key's edge was hit; the key drift is learned faster at first.
- Notes: formatting row with bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, highlight, bullet, numbered list, checklist, quote and heading, applied to the selection; markdown view shows them.
- Notes: save as PDF or as an image (text, then the pen drawing).
- Notes: cards are rounded and two per row on a phone; a coloured note tints its card; a note's pen drawing shows on its card; the new-note button is a round pen at the bottom right.
